pattern_tile_puzzle.name: Pattern Tile Puzzle
pattern_tile_puzzle.description: Create patterns on a small tile grid. Watch them repeat across a carpet. Handmade meets computational - from textile traditions to pixel art.

pattern_tile_4x4.name: 4x4 Pattern Tile
pattern_tile_4x4.description: Basic 4x4 tile pattern editor. Simple repeat mode.

pattern_tile_8x8.name: 8x8 Pattern Tile
pattern_tile_8x8.description: Larger 8x8 tile for more complex patterns.

pattern_tile_brick.name: Brick Pattern Tile
pattern_tile_brick.description: Tile with brick/half-drop offset. Classic masonry pattern.

index_visualizer.name: Index Visualizer
index_visualizer.description: Displays current grid position as array index [row, col].

pattern_tile_cube.name: Pattern Tile Cube
pattern_tile_cube.description: Small grabbable color cube for pattern tile puzzle. Drag to grid cells to place colors.

step_sequencer.name: Step Sequencer
step_sequencer.description: 2D step sequencer with click-to-toggle grid. Arrays as sound - playhead reads indices, triggers sounds.

step_sequencer_synth.name: Synth Sequencer
step_sequencer_synth.description: Synthesizer sequencer with classic synth sounds.

step_sequencer_house.name: 90s House Sequencer
step_sequencer_house.description: Crystal Waters / Gypsy Woman style 90s house. TR-909 kick, M1 piano stabs, acid bass.

step_sequencer_pads.name: Juno Pads Sequencer
step_sequencer_pads.description: Lush analog pads. Juno-106, Jupiter-8, PPG Wave. Slow atmospheric builds.

step_sequencer_kraftwerk.name: Kraftwerk Sequencer
step_sequencer_kraftwerk.description: 1970s Germany. Moog sequencer pulse, robotic precision. The birth of electronic music.

step_sequencer_disco.name: Disco Sequencer
step_sequencer_disco.description: 1970s funk and groove. Four-on-floor, Synare disco tom, funky bass.

step_sequencer_ambient.name: Ambient Works Sequencer
step_sequencer_ambient.description: 1990s Aphex Twin style. Modular textures, drones, ethereal atmosphere.

step_sequencer_jazz.name: Jazz Fusion Sequencer
step_sequencer_jazz.description: 1970s Herbie Hancock. Jazz meets electronics, Moog fusion, DX7 piano.

step_sequencer_chiptune.name: Chiptune Sequencer
step_sequencer_chiptune.description: 1980s 8-bit. C64 SID chip, Amiga tracker, retro game sounds.

step_sequencer_scifi.name: Sci-Fi Lab Sequencer
step_sequencer_scifi.description: Laboratory atmosphere. Hums, data chirps, electromagnetic interference.

step_sequencer_cinematic.name: Cinematic Sequencer
step_sequencer_cinematic.description: 1980s Blade Runner. CS-80 brass, Jupiter strings, Vangelis influence.

step_sequencer_breakbeat.name: Breakbeat Sequencer
step_sequencer_breakbeat.description: 1990s jungle/DnB. Syncopation, chopped samples, fast hi-hats.

step_sequencer_cosmic.name: Cosmic Sequencer
step_sequencer_cosmic.description: 1970s-80s space disco. Jean-Michel Jarre, ARP 2600, cosmic FX.

step_sequencer_lofi.name: Lo-Fi Sequencer
step_sequencer_lofi.description: 2010s chill beats. Warm DX7 piano, mellow 808, study music vibes.

binary_table.name: Binary Table Display
binary_table.description: Show any 2D array as a grid of values. See the data structure made visible.

pulsar_glass_tubes.name: Pulsar Glass Tubes
pulsar_glass_tubes.description: 3D glass tube visualization of Pulsar B1919+21 radio waves. Height = signal intensity. Arrays as art.

pulsar_visualizer.name: Pulsar B1919+21 Visualizer
pulsar_visualizer.description: The first pulsar discovered (1967). Binary table + 3D glass tubes. Joy Division's Unknown Pleasures made interactive.

pulsar_compact.name: Pulsar Compact
pulsar_compact.description: Smaller pulsar visualization. 20 rows of glass tubes.

pulsar_lines.name: Pulsar Lines
pulsar_lines.description: Pulsar visualization using lines instead of tubes. Better performance.

tiling_demo.name: Tiling System Demo
tiling_demo.description: Italian tiling motifs gallery. 17 wallpaper groups, multi-layer composition. Checkerboard to cosmatesque — field study preparation.

facade_grammar_demo.name: Facade Grammar Demo
facade_grammar_demo.description: Architectural facade gallery. Italian presets (Villa San Michele, Certosa, San Gregorio Armeno) plus element library (columns, arches, cornices, rustication).

vr_tile_editor.name: VR Tile Editor
vr_tile_editor.description: VR workspace for designing tile patterns. Edit a grid at desk height, see it tile across a floor carpet in real-time. Cycle wallpaper groups with VR controllers.

vr_tile_editor_mirror.name: VR Tile Editor Mirror
vr_tile_editor_mirror.description: VR tile editor starting in kaleidoscope mirror mode. Design symmetric patterns and see them tile across a floor carpet.

array_carpet.name: Array Carpet
array_carpet.description: A decorative floor carpet displaying the player's tiled pattern from the arrays lesson. Repetition is not boring, it's ornamental.

wfc_tile_mosaic.name: WFC Tile Mosaic
wfc_tile_mosaic.description: Floor panel showing a pre-generated Wave Function Collapse output — a grid of tiles where each cell respects adjacency constraints. Constraint propagation made visible.

pattern_maker_station.name: Pattern Maker Station
pattern_maker_station.description: Interactive wallpaper group station — paint a domain grid on an upright panel, choose from 17 symmetry groups, and watch the tiled result unfold on a large floor carpet in real time.

grid_editor_board.name: Grid Editor Board
grid_editor_board.description: Interactive grid layout editor — Godot VR mirror of the web grid-editor. Control Board subset with 34 elements across 9 categories, 4 presets (Mission Control, Server Rack, Comms Station). Place and arrange control panel components on a 24x14 grid.

grid_editor_board_3d.name: Grid Editor Board (3D)
grid_editor_board_3d.description: 3D interactive version of the grid editor board. Same layout data as the shadow board but with real 3D elements — CRT monitors with phosphor flicker, VU meters with bouncing needles, interactive push buttons, slider faders, rotary knobs, toggle switches, speakers, and blinking LEDs.

grid_3d_capture.name: Grid Editor 3D Capture
grid_3d_capture.description: Procedural 3D builder for all grid editor subsets — chemical models, sticky notes, periodic table, glass racks, big pipes. Accepts subset and preset via config.

facade_builder.name: Facade Builder
facade_builder.description: Interactive architectural facade composer. Five presets (classical, gothic, palazzo, arcade, minimal) with configurable bays, stories, symmetry, and colors. Uses SpatialComposition zones and SurfaceTool geometry.

row_3_x.name: row_3_x
row_3_x.description: Places three pickup cubes in a single row along the X axis.

column_3_z.name: column_3_z
column_3_z.description: Stacks three pickup cubes in the Z direction for spacing tests.

grid_2d_4x4.name: grid_2d_4x4
grid_2d_4x4.description: Builds a 4x4 pickup-cube grid laid out across the floor.

grid_3d_4x4x4.name: grid_3d_4x4x4
grid_3d_4x4x4.description: Populates a 4x4x4 lattice of pickup cubes for volumetric layouts.

IndexVisualizer.name: IndexVisualizer
IndexVisualizer.description: Visualizes current grid index above player

pompeii_mosaic_floor.name: Pompeii Mosaic Floor
pompeii_mosaic_floor.description: Multi-zone Roman mosaic floor from Pompeii. Composes field, border, corner, and threshold patterns using wallpaper group symmetries with opus tessellatum aging effects.

octagon_square_floor.name: Octagon & Square Floor
octagon_square_floor.description: Procedural Pompeii mosaic floor with octagon-and-square tessellation — terracotta diamonds inside light octagons with dark interstitial squares.

tumbling_blocks_floor.name: Tumbling Blocks Floor
tumbling_blocks_floor.description: Procedural Pompeii mosaic floor with tumbling blocks pattern — three rhombus shades create a 3D cube illusion on a hexagonal grid.

perspective_cubes_floor.name: Perspective Cubes Floor
perspective_cubes_floor.description: Procedural Pompeii mosaic floor with perspective cubes pattern — three rhombus shades on a regular rectangular grid create a strong 3D stacked-cube illusion.

diamonds_squares_floor.name: Diamonds in Squares Floor
diamonds_squares_floor.description: Pompeii mosaic floor with diamonds-in-squares pattern. Each cell contains a 45-degree rotated diamond inscribed in a square, alternating dark/light in a checkerboard arrangement.

nested_diamonds_floor.name: Nested Diamonds Floor
nested_diamonds_floor.description: Pompeii mosaic floor with nested diamonds pattern. Each cell contains three concentric 45-degree rotated squares creating a bulls-eye of dark-light-dark-light zones radiating inward.

swastika_meander_floor.name: Swastika Meander Floor
swastika_meander_floor.description: Pompeii mosaic floor with swastika meander (Greek key labyrinth) pattern. Continuous dark meander path on light background with terracotta accent squares at cell centers.

solomons_knot_floor.name: Solomon's Knot Floor
solomons_knot_floor.description: Pompeii mosaic floor with Solomon's Knot (nodo di Salomone) — two interlocked loops forming an infinite knot, a classic Roman/Byzantine decorative motif with over-under weave in three colors.

stepped_zigzag_floor.name: Stepped Zigzag Floor
stepped_zigzag_floor.description: Pompeii mosaic floor with stepped zigzag pattern — interlocking L-shaped steps in three tones create a 3D staircase illusion reminiscent of Escher's impossible staircases.

flower_of_life_floor.name: Flower of Life Floor
flower_of_life_floor.description: Procedural Pompeii mosaic floor with Flower of Life sacred geometry pattern — overlapping circles on a hexagonal grid creating petal shapes at intersections. Dark circle outlines on light background with terracotta accent petals.

polka_dot_field_floor.name: Polka Dot Field Floor
polka_dot_field_floor.description: Pompeii mosaic floor with dark field and scattered small light tesserae in a regular grid with organic jitter. Common in vestibules and corridors, bordered by a meander pattern.

meander_threshold_floor.name: Meander Threshold Floor
meander_threshold_floor.description: Pompeii mosaic threshold floor with bold Greek key meander border framing a dark field with scattered white tesserae. Common Roman doorway pattern placed at transitions between rooms.

star_rosette_floor.name: Star Rosette Floor
star_rosette_floor.description: Pompeii mosaic floor with hexagonal star rosette (hexagram) pattern. Six-pointed stars formed by overlapping equilateral triangles with small rhombi between stars. Classic Roman geometric mosaic.

floor_plan_space.name: Floor Plan Space
floor_plan_space.description: Standalone 3D space builder that loads a floor_plan.json and constructs rooms with facade walls and mosaic floors, independent of the grid system.

radial_mandala_floor.name: Radial Mandala Floor
radial_mandala_floor.description: Procedural Pompeii mosaic floor with concentric radial mandala pattern. A terracotta 6-pointed star rosette at center, surrounded by rings of alternating dark/light triangles radiating outward with interlocking offset.

guilloche_border_floor.name: Guilloche Border Floor
guilloche_border_floor.description: Pompeii mosaic floor with prominent guilloche (braided rope) border surrounding a simple checkerboard grid field with a central terracotta pictorial panel inset. The guilloche band features interlocking S-curves in dark, light and terracotta tesserae.

honeycomb_hex_floor.name: Honeycomb Hex Floor
honeycomb_hex_floor.description: Procedural Pompeii mosaic floor with honeycomb hexagonal tessellation. Regular hexagons in alternating dark/light with dark grout outlines. Every 3rd hexagon features a small terracotta cross motif at its center.

diamond_lattice_floor.name: Diamond Lattice Floor
diamond_lattice_floor.description: Pompeii mosaic floor with diamond lattice pattern. Two sets of diagonal lines at 45 and 135 degrees cross to form a regular rhombus grid. Alternating dark/light diamonds create a rotated checkerboard effect.

multi_zone_carpet_floor.name: Multi-Zone Carpet Floor
multi_zone_carpet_floor.description: Pompeii mosaic floor demonstrating carpet composition — nested rectangular bands of distinct motifs (dark border, sawtooth chevrons, scallop semicircles) surrounding a central checkerboard field. Demonstrates the Roman principle of hierarchical spatial framing.

wave_scale_floor.name: Wave Scale Floor
wave_scale_floor.description: Roman imbrication (fish-scale) mosaic floor — overlapping semicircles arranged in offset rows creating a wave/scale effect. Common in Roman baths and fountains. Alternating dark, light, and terracotta rows with grout arc outlines.

pelta_shield_floor.name: Pelta Shield Floor
pelta_shield_floor.description: Roman pelta (Amazon shield) mosaic floor — interlocking crescent shapes with concave bites arranged in offset rows. A classic Roman border and field pattern where paired crescents face opposite directions, creating a rhythmic shield motif.

basket_weave_floor.name: Basket Weave Floor
basket_weave_floor.description: Procedural Pompeii mosaic floor with basket weave (opus spicatum) pattern. Alternating horizontal and vertical pairs of 2:1 rectangular tiles in a checkerboard arrangement create a woven textile appearance. Dark and light pairs interlock like fabric.

herringbone_floor.name: Herringbone Floor
herringbone_floor.description: Procedural Pompeii mosaic floor with herringbone (opus spicatum) pattern. Rectangular 2:1 bricks laid at 45-degree angles in alternating zigzag rows. Adjacent bricks point in opposite directions creating the classic V/chevron pattern found in Roman and medieval floors.

labyrinth_floor.name: Labyrinth Floor
labyrinth_floor.description: Pompeii mosaic floor with classical 7-circuit labyrinth pattern. A single unbroken path spirals inward from the entrance to the center — not a maze but a meditation in stone. Based on Roman house labyrinths found across the Mediterranean.

san_michele_mosaic_floor.name: San Michele Mosaic Floor
san_michele_mosaic_floor.description: Circular Roman mosaic floor inspired by Villa San Michele, Capri. Concentric zones read from outside in: circular vine scroll border, square Greek key meander frame, dark solid band, classical 7-circuit labyrinth, and a central terracotta rosette.

dense_carpet_floor.name: Dense Carpet Floor
dense_carpet_floor.description: Pompeii mosaic floor imitating woven textile: a dark field covered in hundreds of tiny light crosses arranged in a dense offset grid, creating a carpet/tweed effect.

opus_sectile_floor.name: Opus Sectile Floor
opus_sectile_floor.description: Opus sectile marble floor � large cut stone pieces forming bold geometric patterns. Grid of circles inscribed in squares with triangular corner fills in 4+ marble colors (basalt, terracotta, serpentine green, porphyry red). Cosmatesque / Pantheon style.

spiral_mosaic_floor.name: Spiral Mosaic Floor
spiral_mosaic_floor.description: Procedural Pompeii mosaic floor with Archimedean spiral pattern. A single continuous dark spiral band winds from a central rosette outward on a light background, widening as it goes. Ancient symbol found across cultures from Newgrange to Roman mosaics.

interlocking_t_floor.name: Interlocking T Floor
interlocking_t_floor.description: Procedural Pompeii mosaic floor with interlocking T-shaped tetromino pattern. T-pieces (3 wide x 2 tall) tile with alternating rotations and colors, dark Ts pointing down interlock with light Ts pointing up, creating a satisfying puzzle-like woven surface.

compass_rose_floor.name: Compass Rose Floor
compass_rose_floor.description: Procedural compass rose mosaic floor � 16-pointed mariner's star with alternating dark/light triangular wedges radiating from a terracotta center disc. Inner ring of 8 narrow intercardinal points, outer ring of 8 cardinal points, surrounded by concentric border bands.

windmill_floor.name: Windmill Floor
windmill_floor.description: Pompeii mosaic floor with windmill/pinwheel pattern. Each unit has a small terracotta center square surrounded by 4 L-shaped blades — two dark, two light opposite — creating a spinning windmill effect. Adjacent units rotate 90 degrees for continuous flow.

chain_link_floor.name: Chain Link Floor
chain_link_floor.description: Pompeii mosaic floor with interlocking circles arranged so each passes through its neighbors centers, creating a continuous chain. Classic Roman guilloche derivative. Overlapping areas form pointed vesica piscis shapes filled in terracotta.

pixel_invader_floor.name: Pixel Invader Floor
pixel_invader_floor.description: Procedural pixel art floor with space invader sprites tiled in electric green on a black field. 11x8 bitmap characters march across the ground like an 8-bit arcade screen.

neon_chevron_floor.name: Neon Chevron Floor
neon_chevron_floor.description: Procedural pixel art floor with bold V-shaped chevron stripes radiating from center. Hot pink, electric blue, yellow, and purple bands alternate with black gaps for a rainbow V pattern.

glitch_grid_floor.name: Glitch Grid Floor
glitch_grid_floor.description: Procedural pixel art floor with digital noise aesthetic. Mostly black grid with ~18% of cells lit in hot pink, cyan, lime, red, or white using deterministic hash for reproducible glitch pattern.

memphis_floor.name: Memphis Pattern Floor
memphis_floor.description: Procedural pixel art floor inspired by Memphis Group / Sottsass design. Pastel pink background with scattered black triangles, yellow dots, and teal zigzag shapes placed by pseudo-random hash.

rainbow_checker_floor.name: Rainbow Checkerboard Floor
rainbow_checker_floor.description: Procedural pixel art floor with rainbow checkerboard pattern. Each row uses a different spectrum color paired with black: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple — then repeats.

pixel_cross_floor.name: Pixel Cross Carpet Floor
pixel_cross_floor.description: Procedural pixel art floor with large 5x5 pixel crosses on a dark background. Alternating bright green and hot pink crosses in staggered rows create a bold carpet effect.

turtle_meander_floor.name: Turtle Meander Floor
turtle_meander_floor.description: Procedural mosaic floor whose Greek key border is traced by a turtle graphics engine. The same turtle machine generates the ancient meander, the Hilbert curve, and the Peano curve — different programs, same machine.
